body:

Body **r135**, written 2026-10-04T11:00Z by `session_01CB6W87z22K2yjUCDyVrJRk` (os-project-manager) at its stand-down on the maintainer's word 「你可以下班了」. r134 and earlier revisions are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** — the previous seat `session_01CB6W87z22K2yjUCDyVrJRk` (os-project-manager, seated 2026-10-03T23:29Z) stood down at 2026-10-04T11:00Z; its seat Routine `trig_01Lo2SdVA9dDsWez9aSowqDG` is deleted and no timer of that session survives. The lane's objectui board is objectstack-ai/objectui#11311 (same seat, two boards). **Successor guidance:** `/pm-dispatch skills` + read this post and #11311 first; start from a fresh checkout at `origin/main` — the previous session's shared checkout was two `.claude/**` files behind `origin/main` by that seat's own landings (`references/execution-duties.md`, `references/triage-duties.md`).

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Queue (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`): objectstack 0 · objectui 0** (snapshot at 2026-10-04T11:00Z). **In flight: 0. Landing window: 0. Decision box: 0. Blocked / on-hold: 0.**
- **Findings for triage:** #21719 (bare, filed by the stood-down seat: `check:pm-dispatch-gates` holds the verify lock about 20 minutes per run and starves sibling devs' locked scanner runs — a 可机械化项); #21716 (bare, another seat's, unrouted at this write).
- **For the maintainer, not the seat:** PR #21679 (#21465's complete delivery, +802/−22 on `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`, CI green) stays an open draft under ruling 208 (`references/instrument-discipline.md` line 8); the relay has no PR-close operation. Whether PR #21016's earlier landing on the same instrument is deleted under that line is also the maintainer's (listed by triage on #21465, comment 5976716230).
- **Landed by the stood-down seat, all closed out:** R1 — PR #21650 (#21567) · #21652 (#21415) · #21651 (#21537) · #21656 (#21583) · #21657 (#21601) · #21667 (#21627) · #21677 (#21588) · #21676 (#21467, Tier S) · objectui#11585 (objectui#11511); R2 — objectui#11595 (objectui#11534) · #21685 (#21659) · #21690 (#21675) · #21691 (#21681, Tier S). ## Hot-file serial queue

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: FROZEN (ruling 208 R6). `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`: a report-only instrument under line 8 — no fix card is claimable (triage closes such cards at first grade since PR #21691); PR #21679 open and held. Every other file of the lane: FREE. objectui: every file FREE.

## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name` with `=`) / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` (`--stateless --no-skip-pr-referenced` after the seat strips the state label and assignee; it refuses an owned card) and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (ops: `issue_patch`, `pr_request_reviewers`, `pr_ready`, `automerge_enable`; no close op exists); a body refresh needs `--ack-through=ID` from the LAST comment page. Route: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`).
- **Landing.** Tier H = an authorized APPROVED review, then the seat clears `needs-user-decision` and lands (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`), unless the approver already did; Tier S (`.claude/**`) = at-tier review PASS then the seat lands; non-governed (`scripts/pm/**`) = CI + the seat's at-tier read, through the queue; the enqueue reading is `check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0 plus `check-governed-merges --pr N`. Direct acceptance (draft PR present + CI all green + the subagent confirmed dead + no report) is legitimate with the criteria unreduced (PR #21676 is the shape). A ratcheted `.claude/**` file is paid in place by deleting a restated line whose owning copy stays on the reading path (PR #21676, PR #21691).
- **Platform readings from the stood-down shift:** the shell's working directory resets between tool calls (`git -C` / absolute paths / `(cd … && …)`); a four-stroke relay batch exceeds a 120 s foreground tool call; the 5-hour usage wall terminates in-flight dev subagents and restarts the worker (the wall message carries the reset time; the Routine survives; recovery = direct acceptance or SendMessage resume per 〈断粮与跨墙恢复〉); `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` holds the verify lock 1216–1246 s per run (#21719).
